concerns.text: T012 description mandates raising an explicit error to halt execution if real data fetch fails, directly contradicting FR-001 which requires the system to 'initiate a fallback protocol' (generate simulated data or trigger collection) rather than stopping. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement.

T012_gen invokes `synthpop` to generate 'synthetic landmark/prosody time-series' as a fallback. FR-002 and FR-003 mandate computing features using OpenFace and librosa. Using synthetic time-series to replace the extraction logic violates the 'Multimodal Feature Extraction Integrity' (Constitution Principle VI) and the specific tool constraints in the spec, effectively bypassing the required extraction pipeline.

T026c proposes a reactive 'chunking strategy' only if peak memory > 7GB. SC-005 requires the analysis to complete within constraints (6h, <7GB RAM). A reactive fix that triggers *after* a violation occurs does not satisfy the success criterion; the task must include proactive optimization (e.g., streaming/batching) to ensure the constraint is met before execution.

T017 requires framing results as associational in 'console logs, CSV headers, report text'. SC-004 requires this framing in 'ALL outputs'. The task description omits the visualization output (T023/T025) and the regression report headers (T020/T021), creating a gap where the associational disclaimer might be missing from critical deliverables.

T023 implements `verify_wcag_contrast()` for pixel contrast but fails to specify a mechanism to enforce the 'minimum axis-label font size' requirement from SC-003. Without a quantitative check for font size, the task does not fully satisfy the acceptance criteria for visualization quality.
